remarks: Located in a premier downtown location with the area's best dining, shopping and MetroNorth just steps away! This chic and sophisticated historic building offers boutique living with ONLY 7 loft-style units, offering a low-density and high quality housing alternative to the large scale high rise developments in Stamford. 1 BR, 1BA, gorgeous exposed brick, weathered character white oak floors and high ceilings with recessed lighting. Fully renovated with no expense spared, the unit has an in-unit GE washer/dryer, Samsung stainless steel appliances, Caesarstone countertops, and Moen kitchen and bath fixtures and Pella windows. The building offers an elevator, secured lobby with interior mailboxes, and tenant parking can be reserved at nearby garages for an additional monthly fee. Experience NYC vibes with the ease and convenience of Downtown Stamford! *pictures of a similar unit
